recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO opens a new core issue to retire, replace, or further constrain the example value set for current laboratory implementation needs; that would be a new decision rather than unapplied FHIR-15515 work.
issue_request: FHIR-15515 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for the STU3 Specimen Collection Method example value set. It asked to remove heterogeneous content that was not a collection action, method, or procedure, including named SNOMED CT examples and the HL7 v2/0488 include, and to use the European Trillium II project code set as preapplied in the build.
initial_application: Git commit 0327be9ad279f56409a15463b6759f5fdd687fc9, "GF#15515  update specimen method binding", rewrote source/specimen/valueset-specimen-collection-method.xml by removing the old SNOMED CT examples and v2/0488 include and adding the focused SNOMED CT collection-action/procedure code list. Later commits on that source file changed metadata, OIDs, status, or formatting and did not reintroduce the removed content.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini includes specimen=Specimen in the active [resources] list, so the Specimen folder and its value set source are in current build scope. Specimen.collection.method still example-binds to the FHIR core specimen-collection-method value set, whose current source contains the ten replacement SNOMED CT concepts and none of the named obsolete examples or the v2/0488 include. A Zulip OO agenda message records GF#15515 as Persuasive and preapplied; Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-15515 reference or later core decision reversing the cleanup. FHIR-19426 is nearby background about SpecimenDefinition collection binding and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The empty audit commit records that the current source already embodies the published/preapplied FHIR-15515 resolution and that changing the binding to the historical ART-DECOR URL would not match the applied FHIR core source history.

related_jiras.note: Separate SpecimenDefinition collection binding issue already audited on the combined branch; it does not alter the FHIR-15515 value set cleanup.
